description: Says where a relayed platform notice belongs, as the relay thread's Link, Move and Unlink do: action 'link' or 'move' with clientId puts it on that client's conversation (and teaches the address); action 'unlink' with rule { id, name } takes it off the relay rule that brought it. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat on an unchanged message writes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: link_relay_message
title: Link, move or unlink a relayed platform notice
